user.title: WhatsApp Bridge — Terms of Service
user.description: This integration uses an unofficial WhatsApp client (whatsapp-web.js). WhatsApp's Terms of Service do not allow bot-style use of personal accounts and your account may be banned. We strongly recommend using a secondary phone number, not your primary one. Read the {tos_url}. You must accept this risk to continue.

data.tos_accepted: I understand and accept the risk

connection.title: Connect to the WhatsApp Bridge add-on
